items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I was with Walker Fuller. We had a small band, after Earl's band broke up. I stayed with Walker Fuller.

ctx.x: What was the last big band that you were with?

Dolgarn, I believe it was Earl. Because after Earl I went with Walker Fuller. That's right, I was with Walker Fuller. We had a small band, after Earl's band broke up. I stayed with Walker Fuller. I was with him about two, three years.
